title: Five-Star Setup
narrativeText: R-V-D! R-V-D! The crowd chants your name before you even set foot in the ring. You climb to the top rope. The crowd holds its breath. Everything that makes you special comes down to this — the Five-Star Frog Splash.

choices.label: Launch From the Top
choices.text: Everything you have. The whole crowd on its feet.

title: Rolling Thunder
narrativeText: The crowd is already chanting your initials. The opponent stands in the center of the ring trying to look unimpressed. You run the ropes — Rolling Thunder. The building erupts. No DQ means no limits on what comes next.

choices.label: Rolling Thunder Into the Brawl
choices.text: The signature move opens the door. Now finish what you started.
